Paper Name: Optimal design and energy management of a hybrid PV-Wind system with hydrogen and gravity energy storage: An off-grid sustainable alternative for coal power in Morocco
NOTES: This paper replaces a 624 MW USC coal plant in Morocco with PV-WT-H2-GES; no diesel generator or battery used. GES is included instead of battery storage. Table 4 shows Mtank=2.60 tonne while abstract/conclusion consistently state 260 t storage tank — possible unit discrepancy. COE and LCOE are used interchangeably in the paper. Paper uses HHV (39.7 kWh/kg) for H2, not LHV. LCOE in Table 4 is 0.239 Euro/kWh but abstract states 0.23 €/kWh. No inverter specified separately. System is off-grid with no grid connection (p_grid=null).
